articles.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
articles.summary: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.
